Definition: properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend
BiblicalUsage: 1) to strive, contend; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to strive; 1a1a) physically; 1a1b) with words; 1a2) to conduct a case or suit (legal), sue; 1a3) to make complaint; 1a4) to quarrel; 1b) (Hiphil) to contend against
